scope: Sensor-anomaly email, Directus, and actuator failure logging

behavior.email: SMTP exception details are replaced with the exception class while delivery remains best effort.
behavior.directus: Directus exception details are replaced with the exception class while delivery remains best effort.
behavior.actuation: Owned-connection dispatch failures log only the exception class; critical severity still forces human approval.

coverage: secret-bearing SMTP and Directus failures are redacted from logs
secret-bearing actuator failure is redacted and connection cleanup runs
critical actuator command continues to require human approval

static_checks.database_or_delivery_access: none; mocked SMTP, HTTP, connection, and actuator boundaries

limitations: No mail server, Directus instance, MQTT broker, or database was contacted.
This does not establish delivery destination ownership or end-to-end actuator acceptance.
